data_api_reasons.unknown_param: Remove the parameters this operation does not take.
data_api_reasons.bad_value: Check the type and the range of this parameter.
data_api_reasons.bad_domain: A domain is a list of [field, operator, value] conditions and the prefix operators &, | and !.
data_api_reasons.too_deep: Paths follow at most 4 fields and sub-domains nest at most 4 levels.
data_api_reasons.unknown_field: Call describe for the model's field names.
data_api_reasons.not_readable: The field is hidden or the user may not read it; describe lists the fields the user may use.
data_api_reasons.not_filterable: This model hides data when it is read: filter, sort and group only on id and its public fields.
data_api_reasons.not_searchable: The field is computed without a search method, so Odoo cannot filter on it; filter on fields describe marks searchable.
data_api_reasons.not_sortable: Sort on fields describe marks sortable.
data_api_reasons.not_groupable: Group on fields describe marks groupable.
data_api_reasons.not_relational: Only relational fields can be followed with a dot or with any / not any.
data_api_reasons.bypass_relation: This relation ignores the related model's access rules: search the related model first, then filter on its record ids.
data_api_reasons.no_relation_access: The user may not read the model this relation points to.
data_api_reasons.no_model_access: The user may not read this model.
data_api_reasons.bad_operator: Use =, !=, >, >=, <, <=, =?, in, not in, like, not like, ilike, not ilike, =like, =ilike, any or not any (child_of and parent_of are not available); on relations compare record ids, or match names with =, in, like or ilike.
data_api_reasons.bad_order: Use field, field asc or field desc items separated by commas.
data_api_reasons.bad_aggregate: Use __count, field:sum|avg|min|max on numeric fields, or field:count|count_distinct on stored fields.
data_api_reasons.granularity_required: Append :day, :week, :month, :quarter or :year to a date field (or :hour to a datetime field).
